name: Wireless Communications
summary: The physical layer of modern wireless systems: fading channels, diversity, OFDM, MIMO, multiple access and the design of 4G/5G links.

topics.name: Path loss, shadowing and multipath fading (Rayleigh, Rician)
Doppler spread, coherence time and coherence bandwidth
OFDM and OFDMA: cyclic prefix, PAPR, synchronization
MIMO: spatial multiplexing, capacity and beamforming
Multiple access: FDMA, TDMA, CDMA, OFDMA and NOMA
Cellular concepts: frequency reuse, interference, handover
RF impairments (phase noise, IQ imbalance, PA non-linearity)
